requirements.title: Analysis Authority - Grant Issuance
requirements.description: Analysis authority must issue grants bound to exact store, batch, and report snapshot

requirements.title: Analysis Authority - Revision Binding
requirements.description: Analysis grants must bind to latest Stage5 revision and fail when stale

requirements.title: Execution Grant - Authority Validation
requirements.description: Execution grants must validate current store authority and Stage6 session

requirements.title: Execution Grant - Session Binding
requirements.description: Execution grants must bind to current Stage6 identity and session

requirements.title: Mission Domain - Store Isolation
requirements.description: Mission, Policy, Experiment, and AnalysisRun must be strictly store-scoped

requirements.title: Mission Domain - CRUD Operations
requirements.description: Mission domain must support create, read, update, and archive operations

requirements.title: Data Pipeline - Formal Gate
requirements.description: Analysis must block when 8-report snapshot is incomplete

requirements.title: Data Pipeline - Report Completeness
requirements.description: System must track and validate all 8 required report types

requirements.title: Data Pipeline - Lingxing Collection
requirements.description: Lingxing collection coordinator must automate report downloads

requirements.title: Data Pipeline - SSO Session
requirements.description: Lingxing SSO must maintain valid ERP session

requirements.title: Data Pipeline - Collection Coordinator
requirements.description: Collection coordinator must orchestrate multi-report workflows

requirements.title: AI Adapter - Strategy Diagnosis
requirements.description: AI adapter must generate structured strategy diagnosis

requirements.title: AI Adapter - Action Reasoning
requirements.description: AI adapter must explain recommended actions with evidence

requirements.title: AI Adapter - OpenAI Compatibility
requirements.description: AI adapter must support OpenAI-compatible providers

requirements.title: Decisioning - Recommendation Eligibility
requirements.description: Recommendations must validate against current authority before approval

requirements.title: Shared Types - Authority Identity
requirements.description: Shared types must define authority identity contracts

requirements.title: Shared Types - Repository Integration
requirements.description: Preload API must expose authority contracts to renderer

requirements.title: L2 Engineering - Typecheck
requirements.description: All workspace packages must pass TypeScript strict mode

requirements.title: L2 Engineering - Renderer Build
requirements.description: Renderer must build without errors

requirements.title: L2 Engineering - Package Scripts
requirements.description: Package scripts must pass contract verification

requirements.title: L3 Business UI - Mission Control Shell
requirements.description: Mission Control shell must provide workspace navigation

requirements.title: L3 Business UI - Workspace Routing
requirements.description: Workspace routing must isolate store context

requirements.title: L8 Readiness - Aggregation Verifier
requirements.description: L8 aggregation must validate all gates and generate readiness report

requirements.title: Operating Mode - Per-Store Configuration
requirements.description: Each store must persist its own operating mode (人工审批/半自动/策略内自动)

requirements.title: Operating Mode - Mode Switching
requirements.description: Mode switching must require explicit confirmation dialog

requirements.title: Execution Safety - V1 Action Scope
requirements.description: V1 must permit only keyword bid adjustments

requirements.title: Execution Safety - Fail-Closed Gates
requirements.description: Execution must validate 8/8 reports, analysis completion, Ads session, store match, action type, approval, and readback requirement

requirements.title: Analysis Run - Lifecycle Management
requirements.description: Analysis run must progress through creation, verification, analysis, generation, and completion

requirements.title: Analysis Run - Supersession Logic
requirements.description: Re-running identical input must supersede older run and its recommendations
